* Reads all tags within the currently open tag into a serialized representation of a * {@link VibrationEffect}, skipping any validation for the top level tag itself. * *

This can be reused for reading a vibration from an XML root tag or from within a combined * vibration, but it should always be called from places that validates the top level tag.
